lesson: The trade failed because it attempted to short an asset already deeply oversold on higher timeframes, ignoring the potential for a mean-reversion bounce. The system correctly identified the trend but failed to account for the exhaustion of selling pressure indicated by the RSI divergence.
adjustment: Require a confirmed break of structure (BOS) on the 4H timeframe before entering a continuation short when the daily RSI is below 30.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI oversold conditions more as a filter to avoid shorting into potential liquidity sweeps.
